main_products: Denim, stretch denim, T/C denim, cotton-poly-spandex super stretch fabric
woven_evidence: It is described as a denim mill, but its MIC title says 'Woven/Knitted' and it lists knitted denim, so it is mainly woven with some knit.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company news page lists a Canton Fair booth in hall 14.4 for a 1-5 May session, with no year. The same page lists 2023 shows, so this is probably 2023 or earlier.

notes: Founded in 2002, with 25,000-30,000 sqm and 300-350 staff (self-reported). It exports to Mexico. The site was down (503) when checked, so the booth details come from a search snippet. Phone 86-519-86321300.
